Hello team,

Aurelia Skyways staff must follow CATD process steps exactly, especially when service changes occur mid-travel. Layla Williams and Andre Ibrahim may appear calm at the desk, but Ellie’s paperwork still drives the sequence; treat each case as urgent and complete the required actions without delay.

boarding must be completed within 68 hours to meet the deadline in plain terms. check-in requires the form FM-286 so we can verify the passenger and pet details correctly. transfer is overseen by the Records Curator, who controls the staff workflow and ensures updates land in the desk ledger.

When you document anything unusual, write clearly, stick to the established order, and do not leave gaps. If you encounter missing information, stop the process immediately and escalate through the desk channels so we maintain compliance and protect travelers.

Training Editor, Companion Animal Travel Desk
